name: Production Live
description: Phase 5 — Delivery and Operations. The release is traceable, observable and reversible before it goes live.

requiredArtifacts.validation: Release scope, deployment steps, rollback procedure, observability checklist all present and complete
Metrics nominal, logs flowing, traces complete for all production paths; structure conforms to observability-validation.schema.json
Rollback steps documented and tested. Last good version identified. Rehearsal evidence confirms rollback within budget.
On-call team briefed with runbook references, escalation paths, alert ownership, and SLA acknowledgement confirmed.
Deployment artifacts (images, configs) traceable to RC
